message: Original PDF 25 speaks of the homology class of v in V_k without restating the cycle condition; preserved verbatim in meaning without adding an assumption.
The printed Maxwell sequence is 1,1,2,4,4,5,5,6,7,7,10,10,13,13,..., whereas the Exact row in Table 1.4 is 1,1,2,4,4,5,5,8,9,9,10,10. Both are preserved exactly; no mathematical correction.
The annular domain is printed without extra grouping around the Cartesian product after set difference. Preserve the displayed delimiters rather than silently adding parentheses.
Original English has the grammatical form 'there is also be'. Chinese preserves the stated existence claim without treating the English typo as additional mathematics.
Three accepted sample symbols use mathcal Z/B, but original PDF 25-26 embeds EUFM10 Fraktur Z/B. Accepted text must not be corrected without explicit user authorization.

details.authorization_needed: Correct only the three logical Z/B expressions from mathcal to mathfrak in the accepted source/translation/registry and regenerate verified output; do not change H or other content.
